name: Kenya Lake System in the Great Rift Valley
description: Three shallow lakes (Bogoria, Nakuru and Elementaita) lie in Kenya's Rift Valley and together cover about 32,000 hectares. Their waters draw huge flocks of lesser flamingos, which feed here more than anywhere else on Earth, along with nesting great white pelicans. On the surrounding shores you might also spot black rhino, Rothschild's giraffe, lions and cheetahs.
